meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数据或地图变成动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想做会动的标题、图表或地图,又不想学专业软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn headlines, data, or maps into short animated videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to bring titles, charts, or maps to life without learning pro software.

howto.what: 按你的要求制作一段短小的动态图形视频,通常 10 秒内、无旁白,涵盖动态文字、数字跳动、图表动效、Logo 开场、地图动画等。它会自动规划、收集素材、设计并构建,最终输出 MP4 或透明背景视频。
howto.when: 当你提出要制作短小、无旁白的动态图形(如文字动效、数据图表、Logo 开场等)时触发;更长、带旁白或多场景的需求会转给其他技能。

say.text: 把这句话做成动态文字视频:'持续前进',10秒内。
say.note: 会生成 kinetic-type 动态文字视频。

say.text: 做一个数字从0数到100万的统计动画。
say.note: 对应 stat 类目,含数字跳动。

say.text: 把这个新闻链接做成动画卡片。
say.note: 走 news 搜索驱动类别。

howto.what_en: Makes short design-led motion graphics (usually <10s, no narration): kinetic typography, stat count-ups, charts, logo stings, map animations, etc. It plans, sources assets, designs, builds, verifies, and renders to MP4 or transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a short, unnarrated motion graphic (e.g., kinetic typography, data chart, logo sting). Longer, narrated, or multi-scene requests route to other skills.

say_en.text: Turn this sentence into a kinetic typography video: 'Keep going', under 10 seconds.
Make a stat animation counting from 0 to 1,000,000.
Animate this news link as a card.
